summary: Jupiter Neurosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts follow-on offering of 7,142,858 shares of common stock at $0.28 per share, targeting gross proceeds of ~$2.0M. The $0.28 offer price represents a ~36.6% premium to the prior day's close of $0.2050. D. Boral Capital serves as placement agent, earning 7.0% cash fees with no minimum sales requirement and no escrow/trust arrangement. The filing is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, restructuring, or other transformational elements. The structure is a straightforward underwritten public offering with no collateral, overhang, or regulatory clock beyond standard settlement.
